name: Jareth Thomas
title: Warehouse, Fulfillment & Operations Professional
summary: Reliable warehouse and operations professional with experience supporting receiving, inventory tracking, production, material handling, and hands-on problem solving in fast-paced environments. Known for maintaining safety standards, documentation accuracy, quality control, and steady workflow while supporting team productivity targets. Brings a strong ownership mindset, adaptability, and dependable operational support across warehouse, manufacturing, and service-based work.

skills.name: Workplace Strengths
keywords: Ability to work in fast-paced environments

bullets: Direct day-to-day operations for a residential repair and property maintenance business, overseeing jobs from estimate through closeout with strong ownership and follow-through.
Manage scheduling, customer communication, and job sequencing to maintain workflow, support productivity, and keep work moving on time.
Coordinate material sourcing, jobsite readiness, and field execution to reduce delays and improve material flow efficiency across active projects.
Resolve electrical and mechanical issues on-site to keep work progressing safely, maintain quality standards, and prevent repeat problems.
Maintain accurate estimates, invoicing, and service documentation while upholding reliable service and consistent work quality.
Coordinated receiving and inspection of inbound steel coils to support production goals in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Validated shipment data and entered inventory transactions accurately to maintain inventory accuracy, material traceability, and documentation control.
Partnered with purchasing and operations teams to verify order documentation, reduce receiving errors, and keep materials available for production.
Maintained organized staging areas and safe material flow processes to support floor readiness, quality control, and operational efficiency.
Installed residential electrical systems while coordinating with builders and crews to keep workflow on track in a deadline-driven environment.
Performed rough-in inspections and troubleshooting to identify issues early, support quality standards, and reduce downstream delays.
Conducted final system checks and quality walkthroughs to help ensure accurate, inspection-ready work.
Managed warranty service calls, prioritized repairs, and communicated clear next steps to keep service work organized and moving.
Executed precision cutting operations to meet order specifications, support downstream workflow, and maintain quality requirements.
Operated forklifts and overhead cranes to move materials safely and maintain efficient material flow across the shop.
Performed preventive maintenance and flagged equipment concerns early to reduce downtime and protect production continuity.
Administered communication and workstation systems to support reliable day-to-day team operations.
Standardized equipment setup and maintenance practices to improve system consistency and readiness.
Delivered frontline IT support and monitored performance, resolving issues quickly to minimize disruptions.
Supported staffing and operational oversight by coordinating assignments and follow-through across teams.
Led daily shop floor workflow, balancing labor and priorities to support productivity targets and on-time order completion.
Managed SAP order documentation and invoicing with attention to accuracy, supporting smooth handoff between departments.
Trained and supported team members on safe operation of saws, forklifts, and overhead cranes in a team-based environment.
Verified completed orders and quality checkpoints before shipment to protect inventory accuracy and reduce avoidable issues.
Maintained line output by assembling double oven units in a high-volume, fast-paced production environment.
Completed component installation and in-process quality checks to meet build standards and support production efficiency.
Coordinated truck unload and backroom organization to keep inbound inventory moving efficiently and support store operations.
Replenished the sales floor based on demand priorities while maintaining inventory accuracy and organized stock flow.
Prepared opening-floor standards and merchandising readiness each day to support team productivity and customer-facing quality.
Conducted routine patrols and monitored assigned posts to maintain site safety and policy compliance.
Documented and escalated safety or security concerns promptly to leadership for corrective action.
Oversaw inmate intake and release procedures with strict attention to policy, safety standards, and documentation accuracy.
Performed regular security rounds and compliance checks across holding areas to maintain order and identify issues early.
Maintained facility order and responded to incidents quickly to protect people, support team operations, and reduce disruptions.
Provided IT support and maintained computer systems.
Assisted staff with troubleshooting hardware and software issues.
